clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Lydon’s work in Tarren Mill reaches a deadly test. His Elixir of Agony is ready, and he sends Horde champions to Dun Garok for a keg of Shindigger Stout.

Apothecary Lydon serves the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas in Tarren Mill. He has gathered lethal ingredients from across Hillsbrad and finished a new concoction. Frogs and stray dogs are no test for its strength. Lydon wants to see what it does to living adversaries.

Lydon needs a quiet way to carry his experiment. South of Hillsbrad, Ironforge dwarves hold the fortified stronghold of Dun Garok. He sends Horde agents into its underground barracks and mess halls to slip past dwarven rifles and axes and steal a keg of Shindigger Stout.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

Head down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air. Makes Umpi a little nervous though.
So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves? I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally! Now we are ready for action!
